svg.text: host — engine v5, core · object host
A host that runs the machinery.

enrolmenthow the host came to exist (230); an existing host — the first, registered by init — starts enrolled; the add-host tool writes a new host's record in proposed, after provisioning it with the operator's own credentials

rect.title: joined; the disk region takes it from here (205)
provisioned, not yet admitted; the decision shows the platform and the parts, and its yes places the parts' secrets and issues the token (230)
the chosen parts' secrets go to the platform's secret store, then a one-time expiring token is issued; both are effects with proofs
the token is out; the host's first heartbeat with it is the proof it joined
the token expired unused; a decision under attention offers a reissue

svg.text: environmentwhether the host's provider satisfies the environment every repository it declares needs (238); while it does not, the host covers none of that work (lease.coverable reads it) and says so under attention

diskthe host's root on disk, beside its life; `flywheel host join` writes the record and this region clones and checks before the host takes any lease (205); lease.coverable reads it; every tick re-reads the root, so a repository or checkout that goes missing, moves or is changed by hand is found and offered its repair (222)

rect.title: the root is read on the first tick; a host already laid out goes straight to ready
the state, the blueprints and every tracked built repository cloned bare under the root, one shared-line checkout each; a repeat adds only what is missing
the profile's layout holds; the host takes leases and makes places (43, 44)

a hand-made, drifted, moved or missing part of the layout under the root; the host takes nothing, and the decision says the first path that differs, what was expected, and the repair it would run (205, 222)
the repair the decision showed, and only that; a place's worktree needs no response, prepare_place re-makes it from its line (222)

path.title: the host came back; its leases were never expired, its work resumes on it

rect.title: heartbeat within the stale window; every tick also reconciles the host's own disk against the live objects and runs the enumerators whose sources it declares (215, 231)
visible as stale on the status view; its objects are untouched (150)

an intermittent host past its stale window (150a); shown as away with since-when and no attention line; its leases stand, its sessions are neither stalled nor lost and their clocks pause; it becomes the takeover decision only when a decision or approved work waits on it, or at the long bound
an attention line offers takeover; the leases expire only by the operator's response or the long bound

svg.text: ¬(host.last_seen older than 5m)back, with nothing to answer
¬(host.last_seen older than 5m)the host came back; its leases were never expired, its work resumes on it
reply takeover ∨ host.last_seen older than 24h ⚙ expire_leases
decision state · amber pill is the kind
